title: Authority writes belong to core storage only
question: Is the panel writer an extension point?

options.text: Retire the SPI (chosen): Truthful surface, no feature work.
Make writes writer-agnostic: New feature: locks, revisions and participants for foreign stores.

context: Independent architecture review (revision 2) requested by the owner (brief M6, M7). Phase tasks and implementation remain deferred.
decision: Retire StoresGrants from the supported SPI. The core database storage is the only authority writer; panels without it are read-only. Read-source SPI is unchanged. PanelSchema exposes writer capabilities (writable, dynamic permissions) so UIs need no concrete source class.
rationale: ChangePipeline::operate, RoleKeyMigration, ScopedGrantManager, Authorizer and Filament accept only DatabaseSource, so the published SPI promises an implementer path that core rejects. Making the coordinator writer-agnostic would be a new feature; principle 5 rejects keeping an unimplementable contract.
consequences: Filament's DatabaseSource::isDynamic check moves to PanelSchema capabilities.
Contract suites for writers become internal.

evidence.note: Owner requested an independent review and authorized amending Codex decisions within the owner principles.
